title: FrameX
description: A lightweight Fabric optimization modpack focused on maximum FPS, low latency, fast loading, and a clean vanilla experience.
body:
# What is FrameX? 
FrameX is a lightweight Fabric optimization modpack built to maximize FPS, reduce lag, improve stability, and deliver a smoother Minecraft experience while keeping the game clean and vanilla-friendly.

Designed for Minecraft 1.21.11+, FrameX includes carefully selected performance and quality-of-life mods that improve rendering, loading times, memory usage, and overall responsiveness across both low-end and high-end systems.

## FPS Benchmark
This modpack is extremely good for a potato pc like mine. It's the best for all specs. 

| Test | Avg FPS | Min FPS | Max FPS |
|------|------|------|------|
| FrameX Modpack | 350 | 220 | 680 |
| Vanilla Minecraft | 80 | 72 | 91 |

## System Specifications

| Component | Specification |
|------|------|
| CPU | AMD Ryzen 3 3200G |
| GPU | Radeon Vega 8 Integrated Graphics |
| RAM | 8 GB |

## Recommended Sodium Settings

| Setting | Recommended |
|------|------|
| Graphics | Fast |
| Render Distance | 8-10 Chunks |
| Simulation Distance | 4-6 Chunks |
| Max Shadow Distance | 0 Chunks |
| Entity Distance | 50% |
| Particles | Minimal |
| Clouds | Off |
| Smooth Lighting | Low |
| Biome Blend | 0-2 Blocks |
| V-Sync | Off |
| FPS Limit | Unlimited |
| Fullscreen | Enabled |
| Mipmap Levels | 2-4 |

## Reccomended System Specs
